nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address stored as contract owner; written in Ownable constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership, read by owner().
Ownable.newComer: address initialized with _msgSender() at construction and used by the onlyOwner modifier for authorization; never updated afterwards.
WTF._balances: mapping(address=>uint256) holding token balances; written in constructor and _transfer, read by balanceOf.
WTF._allowances: nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of ERC20 allowances; written by _approve, read by allowance and transferFrom.
WTF._tTotal: total token supply constant 1716*10**6*10**18 assigned at deploy; returned by totalSupply.
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender; source of the caller address used throughout the token logic.
Ownable constructor: reads _msgSender(), assigns _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred; also triggers the newComer state initializer.
Ownable.owner(): public view returning _owner; used by _approve to branch on caller identity.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner-guarded function that sets _owner to address(0) and emits OwnershipTransferred.
transferOwnership(): declared private with onlyOwner modifier, therefore it can never be invoked externally (dead/blocked ownership transfer path).
onlyOwner modifier: require(newComer == _msgSender()); authorization is bound to the deploy-time newComer instead of the mutable _owner, so ownership changes never affect the guard.
WTF constructor: assigns full _tTotal to _msgSender() and emits Transfer from a hardcoded address.
_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount): writes _allowances; if ol != owner() it force-sets the allowance to 0 instead of the requested amount.
allowance(address owner, address spender): public view reading _allowances.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount): external entry point delegating to _approve with _msgSender().
transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): moves balances via _transfer then re-writes the allowance via _approve using SafeMath sub.
transfer(recipient, amount): external entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
_transfer(sender, recipient, amount): updates _balances using SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
Address.sendValue: performs a low-level external call recipient.call{value: amount}("") after a balance check; an arbitrary recipient can execute code mid-transaction (reentrancy risk).
Address._functionCallWithValue: low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) on an attacker-controllable target with user-supplied calldata; unchecked external invocation.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address; returned by _msgSender and captured once into newComer at construction.
local variable msgSender inside the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender().

edges.reason: msg.sender is captured at deployment into newComer, which becomes the only address able to satisfy the onlyOwner check.
onlyOwner compares the immutable newComer state variable with _msgSender(), ignoring the mutable _owner.
The caller (msg.sender via _msgSender) is directly compared against newComer inside the onlyOwner require.
renounceOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Ownable constructor obtains the deployer address through _msgSender().
WTF constructor uses _msgSender() as the initial token holder.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner to _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for the allowance update.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner from the deployer address.
The newComer state initializer runs during Ownable construction and permanently binds the authorization address to the deployer.
WTF constructor writes the entire _tTotal supply into _balances of the deployer.
WTF constructor reads _tTotal when minting the initial supply.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom recomputes the spender allowance by calling _approve with the reduced amount.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping for the (owner, spender) pair.
_approve branches on owner() and force-zeros any allowance set by a non-owner caller, breaking standard ERC20 approve semantics.
_transfer performs credited/debited balance arithmetic via SafeMath add/sub on _balances.
renounceOwnership resets _owner to address(0), but the onlyOwner guard keyed on newComer remains unaffected.
transferOwnership would assign the new owner address to _owner (unreachable because the function is private).
balanceOf reads the caller-supplied account balance from _balances.
allowance reads the owner/spender pair from _allowances.
totalSupply returns the _tTotal state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is the sole input argument of transferOwnership and only exists to parameterize its _owner write.
ol is the allowance-owner argument used only inside _approve.
tt is the allowance-spender argument used only inside _approve.
amount is the allowance value written by _approve.
sender argument of transferFrom, forwarded to _transfer and _approve.
recipient argument of transferFrom, forwarded to _transfer.
amount argument of transferFrom, used in the balance and allowance arithmetic.
recipient argument of transfer, forwarded to _transfer.
amount argument of transfer, forwarded to _transfer.
sender argument whose balance is debited inside _transfer.
recipient argument whose balance is credited inside _transfer.
amount argument used in the SafeMath balance updates of _transfer.
account argument indexing the _balances read in balanceOf.
owner argument indexing _allowances in allowance.
spender argument indexing _allowances in allowance.
spender argument of the external approve entry point, forwarded to _approve.
amount argument of the external approve entry point, forwarded to _approve.
local msgSender is the temporary holder of _msgSender() inside the Ownable constructor.
recipient is the payable target of the low-level value call in Address.sendValue.
amount is the value forwarded by the low-level call in Address.sendValue.
target is the arbitrary contract invoked by the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
weiValue is the value attached to the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
